statement.description: Ann has recently started commuting by subway. We know that a one ride subway ticket costs $ a $ rubles. Besides, Ann found out that she can buy a special ticket for $ m $ rides (she can buy it several times). It costs $ b $ rubles. Ann did the math; she will need to use subway $ n $ times. Help Ann, tell her what is the minimum sum of money she will have to spend to make $ n $ rides?
statement.formatI: The single line contains four space-separated integers $ n $ , $ m $ , $ a $ , $ b $ ( $ 1<=n,m,a,b<=1000 $ ) — the number of rides Ann has planned, the number of rides covered by the $ m $ ride ticket, the price of a one ride ticket and the price of an $ m $ ride ticket.
statement.formatO: Print a single integer — the minimum sum in rubles that Ann will need to spend.
statement.hint: In the first sample one of the optimal solutions is: each time buy a one ride ticket. There are other optimal solutions. For example, buy three $ m $ ride tickets.

translation.description: Ann 最近开始乘坐地铁通勤。我们知道单程地铁票的价格为 $a$ 卢布。此外，Ann 发现她可以购买一种特殊的多次乘车票，每张票可乘坐 $m$ 次（这种票可以多次购买），价格为 $b$ 卢布。Ann 计算后得知她需要乘坐地铁 $n$ 次。请帮助 Ann 计算，她乘坐 $n$ 次地铁所需花费的最少卢布数是多少？
translation.formatI: 一行包含四个用空格分隔的整数 $n$、$m$、$a$、$b$（$1 \le n,m,a,b \le 1000$）——分别表示 Ann 计划乘坐的次数、多次乘车票可以乘坐的次数、单程票的价格以及多次乘车票的价格。
translation.formatO: 输出一个整数——Ann 乘坐 $n$ 次地铁所需花费的最少卢布数。
translation.hint:
在第一个样例中，一种最优的方案是每次都购买单程票。当然也有其他最优方案。例如购买三张 $m$ 次乘车票。

由 ChatGPT 5 翻译
